errors.foreign: {path} exists but was not written by this plugin, so it is not overwritten. Pick another target file or move that file away.
errors.invalid: nix-instantiate rejected the generated file, nothing was written: {error}
errors.no_target: No target file is set in the plugin settings.
errors.write: Could not write {path}: {error}. Your user needs write access to the directory of the target file.

notify.remind_export_body: You changed settings in the GUI that are not in your Nix file yet. Right-click the Export to Nix tile to export them.

export_current.one: 1 setting in the Nix file, matches the GUI.
export_current.other: {count} settings in the Nix file, matches the GUI.

export_pending.one: 1 setting, the GUI changed since the last export.
export_pending.other: {count} settings, the GUI changed since the last export.

panel.title: Settings to Nix
panel.usage_body: The file mirrors settings.toml, deletions included. It is your backup: keep it safe, for example in git. To restore, run the nix-build command written at the top of the file, then restart Noctalia.

auto_export.description: Write the Nix file within a few seconds of every change in the GUI, so the backup is always current. Off: export only with the control-center tile, the panel or IPC.
auto_export.label: Export automatically

exclude.description: Dotted paths left out of the export; * matches one level. The defaults are wallpaper paths that change with every wallpaper switch.
exclude.label: Excluded paths

notify.description: Show a notification after a manual export. Errors are always shown.
notify.label: Notifications

remind_export_hours.description: Notify once when GUI changes have not been exported for this long. 0 turns it off; not used with automatic export.
remind_export_hours.label: Remind to export after (hours)

target_path.description: Nix file the settings are mirrored to (overwritten on every export). Keep it somewhere you back up, for example a git repository.
target_path.label: Target Nix file

validate.description: Check the generated file with nix-instantiate --parse before replacing the target (skipped when nix-instantiate is not on PATH).
validate.label: Validate with nix-instantiate
